item.title: RMNP announces temporary closures to protect nesting raptors
item.description: Rocky Mountain National Park (RMNP) has announced that temporary raptor closures are now in effect. Each year, RMNP officials initiate temporary closures in specific areas of the park to allow birds of prey to nest undisturbed.
